title: Gold label for one snapshotted page
description: Also the shape an extractor must output for a page (plus optional per-scholarship confidence, already in the scholarship schema). Each entry of `scholarships` is validated separately against backend/contract/scholarship.schema.json.

review_status.description: draft = one model draft; agreed = two independent drafts matched; adjudicated = a third model settled a disagreement between two drafts; reviewed = a person checked it; second_look = checked twice.

from_scratch.description: Labeled by a human without seeing a model draft (the anchoring-check subset).

vocabulary_gaps.description: Rules on the page the vocabulary cannot express, in plain words.

award_names.description: Listing pages: names of the individual awards the page mentions when their details are not on the page (so they cannot be full scholarship records). Scored later as award recall.

drafted_by.description: Who wrote the draft this label started from, e.g. claude. Absent for from-scratch labels.

adjudication.description: Set on adjudicated labels: whether the adjudicator flagged doubt, and why.
